program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let* ((outer (first (sort (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 4)) (objects g 0))
                             (lambda (a b) (> (obj-size a) (obj-size b))))))
         (inner (first (sort (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 1)) (objects g 0))
                             (lambda (a b) (> (obj-size a) (obj-size b))))))
         (ob (obj-bbox outer))
         (ib (obj-bbox inner))
         (cells (filter (lambda (p)
                          (not (and (>= (first p) (first ib)) (<= (first p) (third ib))
                                    (>= (second p) (second ib)) (<= (second p) (fourth ib)))))
                        (positions-in-rect (+ (first ob) 1) (+ (second ob) 1) (- (third ob) 1) (- (fourth ob) 1)))))
    (paint-cells g cells 8)))
